interpretations: Iris S1 references the same separate stored-attack ability as normal mode, with empty blackboardPrefix, default ATK scale1 and a talent modifier. Stored shots therefore retain normal talent scaling while the main S1 shot reads attack@atk_scale. Harmonie has a feedData1 per-mode group and distinct S1 stored ability. Exact executable data-context dispatch remains unrecovered; independent source review found no contradictory feed/prefix node.

Iris S1 uses the Attack clip preserved by the original animator hook, with uncapped playback fitted to its shortened attack interval; full Unity begin/loop FSM timing is not recovered. Harmonie S1 uses its original fixed .4s preDelay, while normal/stored/S2 use their distinct model events.

Iris wake damage follows the owned sleep buff ON_BUFF_FINISH, including manual dispel, at the source radius.8 with .01s immediate-reach projectile life. Damage uses current source ATK because cacheAtkToActions=false. The initial skill sleeps at its .367s model event plus speed10 travel, and leaves stored attacks intact.

Leonhardt S2 uses the original Skill model event.3s when waitForAttackEvent=1, rather than the serialized fallback preDelay.533s. Normal direct AoE radius1.1 has no projectile. The talent counts the union of base ignoreTargetFree1 aura and expanded targetable-only priority200 aura, avoiding duplicate stack counts for overlapping same-key enemy buffs. The base aura currently also counts alive hidden/disappeared enemy instances; ignoreTargetFree1 proves abnormal-flag bypass, but the executable distinction for physically disappeared entities remains unrecovered.

Harmonie pool preserves fixed Arts damage, immediate first trigger and one-second per-victim cadence. Its slow selector permits one target-free exception (numeric abnormalFlag9/combo2) that has not been mapped; eligibility conservatively follows ordinary ground-enemy targetability rather than granting unrestricted hidden/untargetable bypass. This is an explicit unimplemented exception.

Kjera S2 has two independently persistent funnel controllers with source preDelay.6 divided by AttackS2 playback speed, no first-period wait after that delay, source-invalid cleanup and ordinary target-free checks. Both original selectors have the same single-target priority and no explicit exclusion, so both drones lock the selected target; C# custom controller allocation is not recovered. Drone ramps are tracked independently and missed hidden periods do not accumulate queued hits.

Kjera talent selects its higher replacement modifier for two or more LOWLAND tiles, consistent with the Global description. The template comparison enum is GT with bb.cnt2; its executable comparison operator semantics are not recovered.

Iris S2 and Leonhardt S2 hold subsequent casts and normal attacks through the original full .8s/1.067s clip while damage releases at its model event. Instant SP recovery currently resumes at attack release; the original executable SP/cast-end lifecycle and interaction of explicit preDelay with waitForAttackEvent remain unrecovered. No frame parity is claimed.
Base talents and both skills are implemented. Optional module upgrades and original Unity particle/effect graphs remain outside these adapters.
